Author: Panda
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description: Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try! Needs AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json) and works best with Allagan Tools. Optional: FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf) and Submarine Tracker. Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team, Critical_Impact, erdelf and Infi for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
No database change. Works with any app version.

- The main window says when syncing isn't getting through, under "Last sync", in plain words: for example "Can't reach the database. Check the PC with the database is on, and that Tailscale is connected if you use it." It goes as soon as a sync gets through again.
- A quieter log: a problem like that is written to the log once, not with a long error every sync, and the log says when syncing works again.
- Removed the Read My Character Data and Read My Inventory test buttons from the main window. Check what I can see shows the same and more.
